facts.title: stackcheck
facts.tagline: check consecutive segments of one scroll against its umbilicus, from geometry alone
facts.network: None for local folders. For `https://` or `s3://` segments, the umbilicus or the catalog: the open-data bucket `vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com` (or the host the URL names), for each segment's `x.tif`, `y.tif`, `z.tif` and `meta.json`, the umbilicus JSON, and `metadata.json` for `--transform catalog:...` without a local `--catalog`
facts.success: Exit code 0 means clean; 1 is a completed run that flagged something or could not check something; only 2 means it failed.
facts.not_a_pass: exit 1 with an empty `summary.flagged` (something was not checked); a clean report whose `not_covered` names the segment you care about (the innermost and outermost); a clean run with `--max-normal-um` or `--coincide-um` changed until nothing flags; any report on a stack given out of order or with a winding left out.
facts.never: Say a flag shows which segment left its sheet, or anything about ink or text; run it on segments of different volumes without `--transform`; treat exit 1 as a crash.
